axes.crossvar: average absolute correlation to the within-window cross-variable common factor; zero for univariate windows
axes.frequency: spectral entropy plus a small high/low power-ratio contribution
axes.seasonality: maximum absolute observed-lag autocorrelation over lags 2..48 within the history
axes.shift: first-half vs second-half mean, variance, and slope change
axes.trend: mean normalized least-squares history slope magnitude

binning: LOW/MED/HIGH from legal train-prefix q33/q67 only
